objective: median MAE + mean pinball over11 quarter quantiles + L2 regularization; selection by unregularized joint validation loss
caveats: Offline fitting; no online parameter updates.
Mean constraint applies to median point forecast, not each marginal quantile.
Nonmedian crossing corrected around fixed median; coefficients explain raw linear quantiles.
Conformal temporal coverage is empirical, not guaranteed.
No half-hour marginal quantiles inferred by summing quarter quantiles.
